summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Peruvian SMV material event in which it responds to Official Letter No. 5498-2026-SMV/11.1 concerning disclosure of the Schedule TO and Offer to Purchase dated October 22, 2026 for the U.S. Offer. The offers are a subsequent public tender offer (PTO) by Inversiones ASPI S.A., a subsidiary of Holcim Ltd., and a simultaneous U.S. offer, for the Company's voting common shares. Terms such as price per share, stake, premium and closing date are not specified in the excerpt; the Company is the target and board recommendation is not provided. Watch the SMV response, Schedule TO amendments and tender expiry for the risk-arb angle.
